input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset link is built from `BASE_URL`, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set (src/notifications/templates.ts:8). Since users are seeing localhost links in production, `PUBLIC_URL` is apparently not configured (or not propagated) in the deployment, likely regressing with last week's release. This affects the reset email as well as the rollup and scheduled export emails, which use the same BASE_URL. Needs a fix to ensure PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the production environment, and ideally a safeguard so the app fails loudly instead of silently defaulting to localhost in production.
